title: Ombudsman clears Santa Maria, Laguna mayor in poll-related raps
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Sunday said it dismissed all administrative charges against a Santa Maria town mayor which stemmed from alleged lapses in securing ballot boxes…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Sunday said it dismissed all administrative charges against a Santa Maria town mayor which stemmed from alleged lapses in securing ballot boxes from the 2022 elections. Santa Maria Mayor Ma. Rocelle “Cindy” Carolino was cleared of grave misconduct, gross neglect of duty, and serious dishonesty. On the other hand, the Ombudsman meted a one-month suspension to Municipal Treasurer Ma. Theresa Lagonoy Lontok, which is just a minimum penalty owing to the official’s “unblemished” record as a civil servant for three decades.
